results.title: A Pragmatic CDO's Field Guide to Data Quality — Part 10 ...
results.content: # **A Pragmatic CDO’s Field Guide to Data Quality — Part 10 — The CDO’s 12-Month Playbook: Operating Model, SLOs,** CoDQ**, and Change Management**. We define RACI at the CDE level, establish error budgets, incident response, and runbooks, and build a CoDQ (cost of poor data) model that rolls up to ROI. A maturity model with quarterly milestones guides progress. * **Capability Model Over Tools**: **Data quality (DQ)** initiatives succeed by focusing on core capabilities (**contracts**, **validation rules**, **observability**, **lineage**, **master data management (MDM)**, **reconciliation**, **privacy**, **ML quality**) rather than chasing shiny tools. This chapter presents a **DQ capability model** mapping each capability to concrete acceptance criteria, service-level objectives (SLOs), and evidence artifacts (like data quality scorecards and lineage…. ## Written by Adnan Masood, PhD. Dr. Adnan Masood is an Engineer, Thought Leader, Author, AI/ML PhD, Stanford Scholar, Harvard Alum, Microsoft Regional Director, and STEM Robotics Coach.
